data.body: Fresh non-author review completed for unable-wingless-bustard candidate e393e9a34b1659fa22be712375f5d5889ad14c0e. Four new receipts supersede the stale 86ee matrix and contain 124/124 unique PASS rows. All targets shrink 14,024 to 4,241 words; normalized executable AST, protected prose, inline comments, directives, and shebangs are exact. All 90 amended targets were compared and every changed word sequence was reread against its contract. Change 2973 remains WIP at patchset 1 until that run completes; then patchset 2 may be uploaded.
